title: DeepSeek says it will lower V4 Pro API prices by 75% to $0.435/1M input and $0.87/1M output tokens, making permanent the discount prices set to expire on May 31 (Bloomberg)
commentary: DeepSeek making a 75% price cut permanent isn't a promotion — it's a statement that this is the floor, and every Western lab pricing above it needs to justify the delta with something DeepSeek can't match.
